description: For any code-enumerable axiom set \(T\) in an effective signature, the set of codes of sentences derivable from \(T\) in the actual natural-deduction calculus is computably enumerable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.enumerable_theory_theorems.{u_1, u_2} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (T : L.Theory)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.CodeEnumerable S T) :
  REPred fun n =>
    ∃ A,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode S A = n ∧
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T A
